summary: An offline-first health dashboard for astronauts, with a tamper-evident health log.
details: VitalChain is an offline-first health dashboard designed for astronauts on long-duration deep-space missions where communication delays with Earth are inevitable. It allows astronauts to monitor core health indicators—such as sleep patterns, heart rate, physical activity, stress/mood check-ins, and estimated radiation exposure—and presents them through a clear, traffic-light status system (Green/Yellow/Red) with plain-language guidance. To ensure absolute trust in isolated environments, every health reading is cryptographically secured using an HMAC-SHA256 tamper-evident log (chained to the previous record). If any data record is edited, deleted, or spoofed, the cryptographic chain immediately breaks and alerts the crew. Furthermore, VitalChain's radiation risk indicator dynamically scales using real, live space weather data pulled directly from NASA's DONKI API.
